meta.description: Eight-limbs Muay Thai & MMA move cards (calf kicks, teeps, slashing/rising elbows, clinch knees, clinch shove-breaks) for high-intensity multi-weapon standup wars.

cards.caption_words: steps off-line on his {lead_leg} foot and whips a baseball-bat {rear_leg} shin horizontally into the outside of the lead calf
cards.chain: {lead_leg} foot pivots outward > hips whip through the arc > torso turns low > {rear_leg} shin swings flat > {rear_leg} shin digs into the calf

off_limbs.other_arm: {lead_hand} hand held high at the brow while the {rear_hand} arm swings down-back as a counterbalance, both arms separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} foot pivoted outward as the standing post
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} shin turning over horizontally into the calf

cards.caption_words: has his {lead_leg} calf chopped sideways out from under him, his knee buckling inward as he catches his balance
cards.chain: both feet plant wide > {lead_leg} knee dips inward > hips jolt sideways > torso drops over the stunned leg

off_limbs.other_arm: both arms flaring slightly wide to keep balance while protecting the jaw, clearly separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} knee dipping sharply inward from the calf shock
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} foot planted wide to stop the stumble

cards.caption_words: lifts his {lead_leg} knee high with the shin angled outward to check the incoming low kick bone-on-bone
cards.chain: both feet plant wide > {lead_leg} knee lifts high > torso squares behind the raised shin > {lead_leg} shin locks across the line

off_limbs.other_arm: both forearms held high in a tight Thai guard with the lead elbow touching the raised knee, both arms distinct
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} shin raised vertically as a solid shield
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} pillar leg locked firm on the canvas

cards.caption_words: steps deep into the pocket and whips a razor-sharp horizontal {rear_hand} elbow point across the brow and cheekbone
cards.chain: {lead_leg} foot plants deep > hips whip square > torso turns through the cut > {rear_side} shoulder drives forward > {rear_hand} elbow lands on the cheekbone

off_limbs.other_arm: {lead_hand} palm checking the opponent's lead shoulder, both arms clearly separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} foot planted deep inside the pocket
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} heel pivoting hard to drive the elbow point through

cards.caption_words: pulls down hard on the collar tie and spears his bent {rear_leg} kneecap vertically upward into the solar plexus while standing on his {lead_leg} pillar leg
cards.chain: both feet plant under the clinch > {rear_leg} knee rises > hips drive upward > both hands pull the posture down > {rear_leg} knee lands in the solar plexus

off_limbs.other_arm: both hands locked behind the neck pulling the posture down, both arms clearly separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} pillar leg planted vertical on the canvas
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} knee folded tightly driving upward into the ribs

cards.caption_words: jackknifes forward at the waist inside the clinch as the knee buries deep into his solar plexus
cards.chain: both feet plant flat > knees buckle inward > hips fold forward > torso drops onto the guarding elbows

off_limbs.other_arm: both arms gripping outside the opponent's shoulders as his midsection folds, clearly separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} foot rising onto the toes from the upward knee impact
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} leg bracing back to stay standing

cards.caption_words: plants both open palms flat against the chest and shoves violently forward to break the clinch and create striking space
cards.chain: both feet plant wide > hips drive forward > torso leans through the push > both palms slam into the chest

off_limbs.other_arm: both arms fully extended forward pushing off the sternum, clearly separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} foot bracing firm against the floor
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} leg driving forward through the push

cards.caption_words: is shoved backward out of the clinch to full arm's length, his heels skidding across the floor as he catches his balance
cards.chain: both heels slide back > knees dip to catch > hips rock backward > torso settles over the rear foot

off_limbs.other_arm: both arms spreading wide to recover balance before snapping back into guard, separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} heel skidding back across the floor
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} foot planting behind to stop the slide

cards.caption_words: chambers his {lead_leg} knee high and pistons the ball of his foot straight forward into the sternum
cards.chain: {rear_leg} foot plants flat > {lead_leg} knee chambers high > hips drive forward > {lead_leg} shin snaps straight > ball of the foot lands on the sternum

off_limbs.other_arm: {lead_hand} hand swung down by the hip for leverage while {rear_hand} fist guards the cheek, both arms separate from the torso
off_limbs.lead_leg: {lead_leg} leg extended straight forward into the chest
off_limbs.rear_leg: {rear_leg} standing leg locked upright on the canvas
